status.main_product: Coated, laminated, and metallized polymer films
status.scope_reason: The company manufactures medical-grade polymer films by coating, laminating, and metallizing substrates for medical device packaging peelable lidstocks and printable pharmaceutical labels.
status.evidence: According to Steel Partners Holdings L.P.'s 2025 stakeholder report and official documentation, Dunmore operates from Bristol, Pennsylvania, producing performance-coated, laminated, and metallized films for medical packaging and device applications.

claims.claim: The company reports its Dun-Shield scratch-resistant antimicrobial protective films utilize silver ion technology and are integrated with polyester (PET) or biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) film substrates for applications such as tabletops, touchscreens, furniture, and partitions.

The company reports running 9 coater/laminator lines capable of handling flexible substrates from 24 inches (0.6 meters) to 96 inches (2.5 meters) in width, engineered to handle contract film manufacturing and custom toll lamination.

The company reports toll laminating capabilities that can combine various flexible substrates (including PET, PE, and polypropylene) in thicknesses from 0.25 mil to 10 mil to form multi-layer laminate constructions up to 5 layers thick, utilizing wet and dry, independent or in-line laminating methods.
claims.note: The details regarding "utilizing wet and dry, independent or in-line laminating methods" are unconfirmed by the company's official capabilities statement.

claims.claim: The company reports that all three of its manufacturing facilities in the United States and Europe maintain ISO 9001:2015 certifications to strictly follow measured process standards.

The company reports maintaining ISO 9001:2015 quality management system certification across all three of its United States and European film manufacturing facilities, including its corporate headquarters in Bristol, Pennsylvania.

The company reports offering a proprietary cross-functional product development approach called the Stage Gate Development roadmap, which allows its engineers and chemists to co-develop client-specific custom coated, metallized, and laminated film structures.

Dunmore Corporation provides contract coating and toll manufacturing services for custom programs under strict confidentiality guidelines, producing medical device packaging peelable lidstock barrier films and pharmaceutical label stocks according to its website product specifications.

The company reports operating three global manufacturing facilities located in Bristol, Pennsylvania; Brewster, New York; and Freiburg, Germany, which support its converting capabilities including contract manufacturing of medical packaging barrier films and custom antimicrobial coated medical films.
In 2025, Dunmore Corporation expanded its global medical portfolio by engineering and developing specialized anti-fog films designed to match strict hospital sterilization protocols.
claims.note: anti-fog films designed to match strict hospital sterilization protocols
